Optimum seed rate (30 kg/acre) should be used to avoid dense canopy.
Maintain the optimum level of water in the nursery as well as in the main field.

Maintain black gram, green gram, vegetable cowpea and coriander throughout the year for conserving natural enemies like coccinellid beetles, anthocorid bugs, and staphylinid beetles that feed on both the nymph and adults.
